materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】

使用外文原文書：是

1.	Select 3 different topics and prepare 3 titles (5 papers for each topic) send to Prof. Weng by email
2.	The criteria of papers selection:
	The selected papers should be top 10 of the ranking in the category. Please labeled the ranking information on the paper to show me.
	All papers should make a brief oral presentation when we meet to decide topic.
	As long as the topic has been selected by one of classmates, you are not allowed to use it. (Try to be an early bird…)
3.	All presenters please send me the titles, topics and papers 14 days before your presentation date, and discuss with me at Tuesday seminar class (we have 30 minutes, so only can take a student who is going to give a presentation in coming week).
4.	Presenters ready the PPT and send all your references to all members by email a week before your presentation.
5.	All the attendants have to prepare at least 10 questions in the class for the discussion.
6.	Laptops are welcome to be used in the class.
